correctness.rationale: For each binary word, each complementary triple-pair contributes exactly X+Y-XY. Expanding four factors gives 81 exact restricted languages. A four-state suffix de Bruijn matrix counts each restricted language, and 81 exact adjugate calculations, reproduced in verify.py, reduce to the claimed rational function. Independent streaming enumeration through length 64 and direct words through length 15 agree. A partial-fraction identity and cubic-root analysis establish the infinite recurrence and asymptotic; the threshold at lengths 1 and 2 follows from a short explicit run classification. Finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.
